name: Crypt wall with arched doorway
description: A 1.5 m section of crypt wall, 0.6 m thick and 3 m high, with an empty round-arched doorway about 1.1 m wide and 2.2 m high, in the cool, dark dressed ashlar of the crypt wall section: jamb blocks up to the springing line, a ring of wedge voussoirs with a paler keystone standing a little proud, coursed blocks cut to the arch above it, worn rounded arrises over dark recessed joints and a plain coping. Damp darkens the jamb footings and streaks the faces.

provenance.prompt: A 1.5 m section of the same crypt wall as wall_crypt_straight (dark dressed ashlar, about 3 m high and 0.6 m thick) with an empty arched opening about 1.1 m wide and 2.2 m high in the middle. Cooler and darker than the village fieldstone, with worn joints and a little damp staining.
